title: Positions Heatmap

edits.reason: Intro draws a heatmap ZONE at 84 and markPoints for the squeeze event, but never marks the cluster price as a horizontal LEVEL. Lesson text: 'Long heatmap bright cluster below current price: potential short squeeze fuel if price falls there; also a potential buying support level.' The level is taught as a precise support/sweep target, so it needs a teal markLine (support/buy side). yAxis 84 sits inside the band (~82-116) at the cluster price, non-redundant with the heatmap fill.

This is the only chapter slot that names a heatmap cluster (markLine 'Heatmap Short Cluster') and teaches a 'Spot the blocks' workflow ('Step 1: Spot — Bright Short Cluster', 'Process: identify bright clusters → note price levels → mark on TradingView chart') yet draws NO heatmap visual, while introChart and quiz.chart both render one. Add a heatmap band centered at the 82 cluster (same visual language/color as siblings) so the thing being 'spotted' is actually visible. Separately, the worked trade's destination is taught — 'Step 3: Trade — Bounce at Short Cluster ... Short Cluster Squeezed' — but only as a markPoint at idx15 (~122); add a gold target markLine at 122 ('trade the reaction' destination / take-profit magnet). yAxis 122 is the final leg .to, at the top edge of the band (~80-124).

notes: Verified coordinate sanity for all proposals. introChart band ~82-116 (START 100 → 84,84,114): markLine 84 valid. lessonChart band ~80-124 (START 98 → 82,82,122): heatmap center 82 and markLine 122 valid (122 = final leg .to, at band top). quiz.chart band ~82-119 (START 82 → 101,113,119): cutIndex 8; pre-cut shows only decision context (short cluster markLine+heatmap at 110, inside band) and routes the squeeze outcome to revealMarkPoints (idx 7/10/12/14, all within 15-bar range) — correct slot fit, no pre-reveal spoiler, so it is already complete. Adopted both auditor lessonChart gaps (upgraded the heatmap to a concrete addHeatmap spec and bumped the squeeze-target confidence) and the introChart markLine. Did not find additional missed gaps: intro's 'Current Price Above Cluster' and the squeeze sequence are already covered by existing markPoints. Colors follow chapter convention: teal for the long-cluster support level, pink already used for short-cluster lines, gold for the take-profit target.
